# Commands sprint membership controls and view isolation

Apply visibility client-side: meta boards hide closed cards and abandoned patch links outside Complete; planning hides closed cards and `card.column === "complete"` outside the Sprint column, while Sprint Overview, planning Sprint, and Complete retain them. Register every new browser client module in `commands/graph/constants.mjs`. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
